name: Trivox v9 network, handshake and Xray WireGuard optimization patch
installation: Extract this archive at the repository root and replace files with matching paths.
scope: Live-route connection verification and adaptive startup timing
Documented Xray TCP sockopt and Happy Eyeballs tuning without overriding provider values
Bounded app-side network buffer pooling and memory-pressure cleanup
Non-destructive full-JSON compatibility aliases for Xray protocols and transports
Xray userspace WireGuard normalization and configurable runtime defaults
Complete bilingual Settings UI for the added network and WireGuard controls
limitations: The container could not resolve GitHub hosts and did not contain the complete Android/libXray build environment, so the repository's GitHub Actions test+lint workflow remains the final integration gate.
The app-side buffer setting does not claim to change Go/libXray native TCP or UDP buffer internals.
WireGuard is implemented through Xray's built-in userspace WireGuard outbound; a separate WireGuard-Go backend is not bundled.
Unsupported or removed transports are not silently converted into a different transport because that can break server compatibility.
Full Xray JSON remains the compatibility path for core-supported protocols that do not have an established share-URI parser in Trivox.
